_readme: Topics the auto-blog writes from, in order. Each was checked in Nov 2026 against the 700 existing URLs: none has a dedicated article yet, so writing one adds a page rather than competing with one. The generator still re-checks against live posts before writing and skips any topic the site already covers. Topics typed into Admin > Auto-blog run before these. 'angle' tells the writer what makes the article useful; 'category' is the post category. Keywords are the core phrase without 'how to': the exact phrase has to recur through the article, and 'break soul ties' fits natural sentences where 'how to break soul ties' does not.
